AnswerWaitEnd.description: Why a letter stopped waiting for an answer nobody gave.

oneOf.description: The sender's or the recipient's registration ended.
The letter was sent 24 hours ago and no answer came.

BellTurn.description: The native session and submitted bell digest that own this intake.

ack_command.description: The command that acknowledges the letter, for an agent with no prompt hook to confirm it.

answer_wait_ended.description: Set when the wait for an answer ended without one; null otherwise.

bell_line.description: The line the doorbell typed for this letter last, saved with its reservation before it was typed; null until the first bell. A submitted prompt is that bell when its canonical digest matches this line; older hooks' whole-line digests remain accepted too.

immediate.description: Sent with `hide request send --now`: delivered at the recipient's next safe gap while it works, without the mid-turn wait (PRD letters-to-busy-agents D-05). An older build drops the field at its next save, and the letter then waits as any other.

intake_from.description: Where the letter's wait for intake began: on its recipient machine's clock while the ledger keeps one (`Ledger::node_clocks`), on the wall clock otherwise; null is its creation on the wall clock.

tool_handovers.description: How many tool events handed the letter over while its recipient worked (PRD letters-to-busy-agents D-11): a handover is confirmed by the script once the host kept it, and after three unconfirmed ones the letter waits for the next prompt or `hide inbox`, as it does after three bells.

WarningReceipt.description: The inactivity episode and external notification reservation survive the watch itself, so stopping/restarting or sibling watches cannot resend.

id.description: The registration id; null for an agent Hide did not register.

label.description: The title every surface calls the agent by.

line.description: The row's second line: what it asks, did or waits on.

parent.description: The registration id of the parent the registration names.

parent_machine.description: The live agent this one was delegated by, as the screen nests it.

project.description: The project path the registration names.

watched_by.description: The name of the agent watching this one.

PsMission.description: The open mission an agent conducts or works a node of.

role.description: `conductor`, or the key of the node the agent works.

checkout.description: The checkout's branch, or its folder's name.

machine.description: The device id the pane runs on.

machine_label.description: The name another device was registered under, or its id when it has none; null on this machine.

title.description: The pane's own title, for a pane that holds no agent.

you.description: The pane `hide ps` was run from.

PsState.description: The row's mark as every surface draws it (docs/status-model.md, The mark), `disconnected` for a row on a device that does not answer, and `ended` for an ended registration.

ps.description: `hide ps`: every live pane, where it sits and the agent it holds, and the registered agents no live pane holds (`runtime::ps`).

agents.description: Registered agents with no pane on screen: asleep, on a device that is not connected, or whose pane Hide no longer sees; with `--all` the ended ones too.

missions_unreadable.description: The mission record could not be read, so no row names its mission.

panes.description: In the order the sidebar lists them: by project, checkout and tab.

ps.title: Ps
